'''Homing computers''' were a type of [[Computer/Legends|computer]] that was small enough to be installed on [[Missile/Legends|missiles]]. [[FreiTek Incorporated/Legends|FreiTek Inc.]] used advanced homing computers in their [[EchoBurst concussion missile]].<ref name="EGWT" />
